children: The 12-episode series premieres today, November 18 on YouTube
NEW YORK, Nov. 18, 2026 /CNW/ -- DAZN today launched
Keeping It Real with Tie
, a new original series hosted by NHL legend
Tie Domi

, one of the most well-known players in hockey history. A longtime fan favorite of the New York Rangers and Toronto Maple Leafs, Domi built his reputation as one of the toughest players to ever take the ice throughout his 17 NHL seasons, holding the NHL's all-time record for most career fights with 333. His legendary playing career, larger-than-life personality and longstanding relationships across sports, entertainment and business set the stage for a new series of candid, unfiltered conversations.
Presented by
Sports Interaction Sportsbook & Casino
, the 12-episode series brings fans inside the conversations Domi has shared for decades with some of the biggest names in sports, entertainment and business.
For Sports Interaction, the partnership is an opportunity to spotlight the Responsible Gaming tools available, helping players make informed choices to manage their play.
The series premieres today, Wednesday, November 18, on
Keeping It Real with Tie

goes beyond the traditional interview format, giving fans a rare look inside the conversations that typically happen behind closed doors. Drawing on decades of genuine friendships across sports, entertainment and business, Domi explores the career-defining moments, personal challenges, old-school values and shared mindsets that have shaped some of the world's most successful figures.

"Where I come from, there's no BS, you show up, you work hard and you take care of your people. That never changes," said Domi. "I've been lucky to build real friendships with people from all walks of life across sports, entertainment, business and culture. We're sitting down like we always do and talking about what actually got them there, having unscripted and honest conversations between friends."

A veteran of 17 NHL seasons, Domi became one of the most recognizable figures in hockey history, known for his no-BS attitude. With the most fights in NHL history (333), Domi was known for protecting his teammates and became a fan favorite at Madison Square Garden and in Toronto.
Keeping It Real with Tie

reflects our vision for DAZN Originals – creating compelling content that brings fans closer to the personalities and stories that make sports so special," said Walker Jacobs, Global Chief Revenue Officer at DAZN. "Tie's relationships extend well beyond hockey, giving us an opportunity to introduce new audiences to the sport while connecting existing fans with some of the biggest names in sports and entertainment. We are excited to be building an original content offering that complements our live sports portfolio and gives fans even more reasons to engage with DAZN."

"This partnership gives Sports Interaction a great opportunity to connect with sports fans through authentic conversations with some incredible personalities," said Shir Magen, Head of Canada at Entain. "Just as importantly, we'll use our presence across the 12 episodes to raise awareness of our Responsible Gaming tools and encourage informed, responsible play."
The first episode of
Keeping It Real with Tie
, premieres today, Wednesday, November 18, on the show's newly launched
channel. The series will also be distributed on Spotify, with additional content available across
and TikTok channels.
